scientific_integrity: The prime-order all-support theorem and complete weight/simplex criterion are derived explicitly from stated classical inputs. Numerical examples supplement but do not replace the mathematical proof. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Prime cyclic groups only; arbitrary composite moduli are not covered, with an explicit order-six counterexample.
Only existence and optimal count of positive Parseval weights; no stability or uniform weight lower bounds.
The proof invokes classical Chebotarev, Caratheodory, Cauchy-Davenport, and Vosper theorems.
Potential equivalent treatment in unindexed positive cubature, scalable-frame, or additive-combinatorial literature remains unexcluded.
title: Difference-set rigidity for positive Fourier tight frames on prime cycles
